about.title: About
about.text: Backend developer and intelligent systems architect focused on applied AI. I work connecting data pipelines, LLMs, multi-agent systems and integrations with APIs, legacy systems and external services, using Node.js, TypeScript and Python. I work with generative AI, including LLMs, RAG and process automation, as well as cloud environments (GCP), Docker and databases like Firestore, MongoDB and Redis. I also have front-end development experience with React and JavaScript.
